name: grandMA3
error: "{value}": only playback commands may be sent to grandMA3 (go+, go-, go, goback, goto, pause, off, on, flash), one at a time

rules.source: MA3 manual, Remote Inputs OSC: address /cmd, type s; the manual's own example is Go+ Exec 402
MA3 manual; only playback command words are allowed so a show file can never delete, store or overwrite anything on a console

notes: Turn on Receive Command in the console's OSC settings.
